Each visible reform trajectory has its own paired baseline, and extra repetitions run sequentially while preserving the initial society. Pace changes scheduling and rendering, not the model’s probability rules. Pausing or stepping continues the same event identity; starting another run normally creates a fresh future-event seed.
entries.technical: worker imports the same model/config/profile/baseline/adaptation/reporting code used by Node tests. Each advance steps reform then baseline, and finishPair verifies invariants, stores the first visible trajectory, records per-repetition comparisons and continues if requested. Fast/repetition batches process up to3 months per pump; normal visible pace processes1. Completion includes full events/cases/conduct/final profiles and reporting; baseline summary includes metrics, history and reporting. Page visibility change pauses an active run. The app requires HTTP(S) for workers; GitHub Pages serves static assets with cache-version queries. The v1 directory is an archived earlier model, not a second current specification.
entries.limitations: No installed application, server-side simulation, external API key or live national data feed is required. Actual Android runtime/memory remains unbenchmarked.

entries.title: Engineering verification and audit reproducibility
entries.narrative: An auditor should be able to trace a statement to a mechanism, a source implementation and an appropriate check. Engineering tests examine consistency, replay, actual observation counts and selected causal pathways. They do not establish the empirical truth of the coefficients. This documentation therefore provides source hashes, function references, complete numeric occurrences, consequence arrays, rule coverage and an explicit gap register alongside the prose.
entries.technical: Runtime invariants require exactly 1,000 people, nonnegative finite balances, total-money conservation within.001 RU, no shared-time overspend beyond 1e−6, valid bounded psychological/financial profiles, <=24 meaningful entries and positive unit-sum motives. Tests cover all ten profiles/extreme conditions, maximum 240-month scenarios, paired identity/replay, workers, policy learning, meaningful actions, observer non-mutation, saved-state verification and rendering harnesses. Audit tooling compares normalized parsed ASTs of all ten annotated runtime JS modules against the pinned baseline, ignoring only formatting/comments/locations; it validates reference IDs, links, manifests and generated indexes. Executed checks are recorded separately from the generated test catalogue; publication commits and workflow URLs identify subsequent CI runs. A passing test file is mapped as evidence of covered assertions, not proof of an entire social theory.
entries.limitations: No comprehensive sensitivity analysis, out-of-sample calibration, national ranking validation, independent replication or Android performance certification has been completed.

entries.title: Evidence, assumptions, gaps and change control
entries.narrative: Transparency requires showing what is missing as well as what is present. The agreed design is broader than some current implementations, and older numerical proposals contain suggestions that were never enacted or were later superseded. This audit preserves that history while specifying the code that actually runs. A parameter printed with several decimals is not necessarily an accurate country estimate. New behavioral repairs should be separate changes, with their own rationale, rather than being hidden inside documentation work.
entries.technical: Every reference entry carries agreement links, source functions, test-file evidence, implementation status and limitations. The generated rule crosswalk covers R01–R62 and AM01–AM06 plus later interface/reporting decisions. Evidence classes distinguish user decisions, conceptual publications, stored country observations, proxies, common engineering priors, generated model state and test evidence. Superseded original v1 rules (binary motives, random wandering, color-only integrity, immediate class-based punishment and score-reset demotion) are not current requirements. Gap records identify empirical, structural, measurement and operational limitations. Semantic hashes prohibit accidental behavioral edits during annotation; future semantic changes require a new reviewed baseline and updated technical entries.
entries.limitations: This is documentation for inspection, not a claim of conformance to every original aspiration or certification under ODD/TRACE. Private supplied documents and copyrighted full texts are not redistributed by the audit package.
